title: Single-sample capability numbers are unreliable; this task family is too ambiguous to qualify routes
summary: Sonnet scored 0.80, 0.55 and 0.70 on identical calls; its earlier single-sample 0.75 (EVR-0005) was one draw. With 3 samples all three routes are indistinguishable (0.67-0.70, overlapping item-level intervals), voting adds <= 0.05, and only 2 of 20 items are answered identically across 9 samples. Consequences: (1) CAP comparisons need multiple samples before any routing claim (policy min_samples_for_qualification = 10 is justified); (2) research_implementation_classification, as defined, measures label/rubric ambiguity more than model capability; (3) route qualification should use task families with objective, deterministic ground truth.

provenance.author_tier: frontier (Opus 5.5) analysis of deterministic eval output
